scope: Independent cases executing actual UI script through the author synthetic-DOM setup, no real browser or Android validation.
checks: Duplicate send does not dispatch a second request or replace pending input
Active request uses selected source snapshot; later choices do not change it
Guided completion leaves newer user edits intact and does not attest model inference
Failure does not automatically retry or overwrite draft on polling
Completion refreshes pending controls after route changes with source picker still open
Unchanged result cannot be confused with a newly finished request
Private hide clears private draft and selected IDs immediately
Unlock returns to saved chat without re-dispatching the interrupted request
Late bridge response from locked session cannot settle current request
New explicit completion settles itself and dismisses interruption notice
Guided mode does not enable local AI permission
Guided reply completes with AI permission off without inventing inference proof
Spanish context guidance is visible with zero selected sources
Delayed progress timer cannot replace an intervening permission error
Finished action preserves intervening permission error
